summary: Examples of include_role: basic, alternate tasks file, passing vars, looping over role names with loop_var, conditional inclusion, and applying tags to role tasks.
questions: How do I include different roles in a loop?
How do I tag all tasks inside an included role?
How do I conditionally include a role?

answer_card.title: include_role examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.include_role: {name: myrole, tasks_from: other}
- ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: '{{ roleinputvar }}'
  loop: ['{{ roleinput1 }}', '{{ roleinput2 }}']
  loop_control:
    loop_var: roleinputvar
- ansible.builtin.include_role: {name: myrole}
  when: not idontwanttorun
- ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: install
    apply:
      tags: [install]
  tags: [always]
```
